UXUC80B is a medical classification code from the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) that designates a transthoracic echocardiography with a dobutamine test [^src1]. 

Within the Danish healthcare system's quality assurance frameworks—specifically the clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation managed by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP)—this code plays a precise administrative role. UXUC80B is officially recognized as one of the valid procedure codes that count toward the completion of an [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] under Indicator 2 [^src1]. When this code is logged in the national health registers, it serves as documented evidence that the required echocardiographic evaluation was performed, directly impacting the calculation of diagnostic quality metrics for atrial fibrillation patients [^src1].
